entities.name: Replayed nonceUE
entities.description: An information element that the MME may include to indicate to the UE to use the replayed nonceUE.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: The Mobility Management Entity that may include the replayed nonceUE information element.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The User Equipment that receives the replayed nonceUE indication from the MME.

relations.description: The MME may include the replayed nonceUE information element in a message.
The replayed nonceUE information element indicates to the UE to use the replayed nonceUE.
